title: higgsfield-ai/higgsfield
title_zh: Higgsfield - 多节点训练不再痛苦

paragraphs.en: Fault-tolerant, highly scalable GPU orchestration, and a machine learning framework designed for training models with billions to trillions of parameters
paragraphs.zh: 容错、高度可扩展的 GPU 编排，以及专为训练拥有数十亿至数万亿参数的模型而设计的机器学习框架

paragraphs.en: Higgsfield is an open-source, fault-tolerant, highly scalable GPU orchestration, and a machine learning framework designed for training models with billions to trillions of parameters, such as Large Language Models (LLMs).
paragraphs.zh: Higgsfield 是一个开源、容错、高度可扩展的 GPU 编排和机器学习框架，专为训练拥有数十亿至数万亿参数的模型而设计，例如大语言模型（LLM）。

paragraphs.en: Higgsfield serves as a GPU workload manager and machine learning framework with five primary functions:
paragraphs.zh: Higgsfield 作为一个 GPU 工作负载管理器和机器学习框架，具有五个主要功能：

paragraphs.en: $ pip install higgsfield==0.0.3 Train example That's all you have to do in order to train LLaMa in a distributed setting:
paragraphs.zh: $ pip install higgsfield==0.0.3 训练示例 要在分布式环境中训练 LLaMa，你需要做的就是这些：

paragraphs.en: from higgsfield . llama import Llama70b from higgsfield . loaders import LlamaLoader from higgsfield . experiment import experiment import torch . optim as optim from alpaca import get_alpaca_data @ experiment ( "alpaca" ) def train ( params ): model = Llama70b ( zero_stage = 3 , fast_attn = False , precision = "bf16" ) optimizer = optim . AdamW ( model . parameters (), lr = 1e-5 , weight_decay = 0.0 ) dataset = get_alpaca_data ( split = "train" ) train_loader = LlamaLoader ( dataset , max_words = 2048 ) for batch in train_loader : optimizer . zero_grad () loss = model ( batch ) loss . backward () optimizer . step () model . push_to_hub ( 'alpaca-70b' ) How it's all done? We install all the required tools in your server (Docker, your project's deploy keys, higgsfield binary). Then we generate deploy & run workflows for your experiments. As soon as it gets into Github, it will automatically deploy your code on your nodes. Then you access your experiments' run UI through Github, which will launch experiments and save the checkpoints. Design We follow the standard pytorch workflow. Thus you can incorporate anything besides what we provide, deepspeed , accelerate , or just implement your custom pytorch sharding from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 从 higgsfield.llama 导入 Llama70b，从 higgsfield.loaders 导入 LlamaLoader，从 higgsfield.experiment 导入 experiment，导入 torch.optim 作为 optim，从 alpaca 导入 get_alpaca_data，使用 @experiment("alpaca") 装饰器定义 train 函数，参数为 params：模型 = Llama70b（zero_stage = 3，fast_attn = False，precision = "bf16"），优化器 = optim. AdamW（model.parameters()，lr = 1e-5，weight_decay = 0.0），数据集 = get_alpaca_data（split = "train"），train_loader = LlamaLoader（dataset，max_words = 2048），对于 train_loader 中的每个 batch：optimizer.zero_grad()，loss = model（batch），loss.backward()，optimizer.step()，model.push_to_hub('alpaca-70b')。这一切是如何实现的？ 我们在您的服务器上安装所有必需的工具（Docker、您项目的部署密钥、higgsfield 二进制文件）。 然后我们为您的实验生成部署和运行工作流。 一旦代码进入 Github，它就会自动将您的代码部署到您的节点上。 然后您可以通过 Github 访问实验的运行界面（UI），它将启动实验并保存检查点。 设计 我们遵循标准的 pytorch 工作流。 因此，除了我们提供的功能之外，您可以整合任何其他内容，例如 deepspeed、accelerate，或者完全从头实现您自定义的 pytorch 分片。

sents.en: from higgsfield . llama import Llama70b from higgsfield . loaders import LlamaLoader from higgsfield . experiment import experiment import torch . optim as optim from alpaca import get_alpaca_data @ experiment ( "alpaca" ) def train ( params ): model = Llama70b ( zero_stage = 3 , fast_attn = False , precision = "bf16" ) optimizer = optim .
sents.zh: 从 higgsfield.llama 导入 Llama70b，从 higgsfield.loaders 导入 LlamaLoader，从 higgsfield.experiment 导入 experiment，导入 torch.optim 作为 optim，从 alpaca 导入 get_alpaca_data，使用 @experiment("alpaca") 装饰器定义 train 函数，参数为 params：模型 = Llama70b（zero_stage = 3，fast_attn = False，precision = "bf16"），优化器 = optim.

sents.en: AdamW ( model . parameters (), lr = 1e-5 , weight_decay = 0.0 ) dataset = get_alpaca_data ( split = "train" ) train_loader = LlamaLoader ( dataset , max_words = 2048 ) for batch in train_loader : optimizer . zero_grad () loss = model ( batch ) loss . backward () optimizer . step () model . push_to_hub ( 'alpaca-70b' ) How it's all done?
sents.zh: AdamW（model.parameters()，lr = 1e-5，weight_decay = 0.0），数据集 = get_alpaca_data（split = "train"），train_loader = LlamaLoader（dataset，max_words = 2048），对于 train_loader 中的每个 batch：optimizer.zero_grad()，loss = model（batch），loss.backward()，optimizer.step()，model.push_to_hub('alpaca-70b')。这一切是如何实现的？

sents.en: We install all the required tools in your server (Docker, your project's deploy keys, higgsfield binary).
sents.zh: 我们在您的服务器上安装所有必需的工具（Docker、您项目的部署密钥、higgsfield 二进制文件）。

sents.en: Then we generate deploy & run workflows for your experiments.
sents.zh: 然后我们为您的实验生成部署和运行工作流。

sents.en: As soon as it gets into Github, it will automatically deploy your code on your nodes.
sents.zh: 一旦代码进入 Github，它就会自动将您的代码部署到您的节点上。

sents.en: Then you access your experiments' run UI through Github, which will launch experiments and save the checkpoints.
sents.zh: 然后您可以通过 Github 访问实验的运行界面（UI），它将启动实验并保存检查点。

sents.en: Design We follow the standard pytorch workflow.
sents.zh: 设计 我们遵循标准的 pytorch 工作流。

sents.en: Thus you can incorporate anything besides what we provide, deepspeed , accelerate , or just implement your custom pytorch sharding from scratch.
sents.zh: 因此，除了我们提供的功能之外，您可以整合任何其他内容，例如 deepspeed、accelerate，或者完全从头实现您自定义的 pytorch 分片。

paragraphs.en: No more different versions of pytorch, nvidia drivers, data processing libraries. You can easily orchestrate experiments and their environments, document and track the specific versions and configurations of all dependencies to ensure reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 不再需要面对不同版本的 PyTorch、NVIDIA 驱动和数据处理库。 你可以轻松地编排实验及其环境，记录并追踪所有依赖的具体版本和配置，以确保可复现性。

sents.en: No more different versions of pytorch, nvidia drivers, data processing libraries.
sents.zh: 不再需要面对不同版本的 PyTorch、NVIDIA 驱动和数据处理库。

sents.en: You can easily orchestrate experiments and their environments, document and track the specific versions and configurations of all dependencies to ensure reproducibility.
sents.zh: 你可以轻松地编排实验及其环境，记录并追踪所有依赖的具体版本和配置，以确保可复现性。

paragraphs.en: No need to define 600 arguments for your experiment . No more yaml witchcraft . You can use whatever you want, whenever you want. We just introduce a simple interface to define your experiments. We have even taken it further, now you only need to design the way to interact.
paragraphs.zh: 无需为你的实验定义 600 个参数。 不再需要 yaml 魔法操作。 你可以随时随地使用任何你想要的东西。 我们只是引入了一个简单的接口来定义你的实验。 我们甚至更进一步，现在你只需要设计交互方式即可。

paragraphs.en: Feel free to open an issue if you have any problems with other clouds.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您在使用其他云时遇到任何问题，欢迎随时提交 issue。

paragraphs.en: Here you can find the quick start guide on how to setup your nodes and start training.
paragraphs.zh: 您可以在这里找到快速入门指南，了解如何设置您的节点并开始训练。
